heroTitle:
Can competitive insurance
protect the frail?
intro: Extend the fair-insurance benchmark to hidden risk types: plan selection, Rothschild–Stiglitz contract space, pooling and separating equilibria, compulsory insurance and premium risk.
attribution: Independent student-written study guide based on Daniele Fabbri’s Fundamentals in Health Economics, Session 7: Is healthcare insurance affordable to the frail? Official slides, charts and textbook materials are not reproduced. Always check Virtuale for the official materials.
